question: Bar-raiser round for an SDE-2 role at Swiggy (Bangalore). After a resume discussion there were two low-level design questions: **design and code a rate limiter using the sliding-window and leaky-bucket algorithms**, and **design a vending machine**. The candidate coded the rate limiter as well. This item covers the rate limiter; the vending machine was a separate LLD problem in the same round.
lookingFor: Knowledge of rate-limiting algorithms and their trade-offs.
Clean object-oriented design: an interface with swappable strategies.
Correct, thread-safe implementation with efficient data structures.
Handling per-user/per-key limits and memory cleanup.
followUps: How does a token bucket differ from a leaky bucket?
How would you make the check-and-update atomic across several servers?
How would you handle a very large number of keys without running out of memory?
What response should the client get when throttled (status code and headers)?
How would you unit test time-dependent behaviour?
